name: Kate Beckinsale career
content: Kate Beckinsale's career highlights: Star of the Underworld franchise (2003-2016); Pearl Harbor, Van Helsing, Serendipity; Studied French and Russian literature at Oxford; Viral Late Show segment speaking fluent Russian with Stephen Colbert

name: Kate Beckinsale personal
content: About Kate Beckinsale: Born July 26, 1973 in London. Daughter of actors Richard Beckinsale and Judy Loe. Daughter Lily (b. 1999) with Michael Sheen; was married to Len Wiseman. Won writing competitions as a teen; battled anorexia in youth.

name: Kate Beckinsale quotes
content: Things Kate Beckinsale has said: I dropped out of Oxford, and now I only speak Russian with the woman who gives me a bikini-wax. See what Hollywood does to you? | I find a lot of things kind of funny and I often say what's on my mind, and then get nine texts from all my friends going, 'What's the matter with you?'

name: Kate Beckinsale voice
content: Kate Beckinsale's speaking style: Razor-sharp British wit — dry, self-deprecating, talks a mile a minute with literary references. Famously funny Instagram captions.
